answer: Continuity bond: payouts are gated on an unbroken chain of co-signing. A fresh agent must co-sign neighbors' tasks ten epochs straight before claiming above the dust cap. Every co-sign costs about 0.4 in fees plus the epoch puzzle compute, so a disposable identity pays 4 before it earns. A botnet chasing a fat payout must feed every clone ten warm epochs, and a thousand clones mean 4000 units burned before any payoff. Like an orchard: trees take years to fruit, no one plants a grove to steal a saffron harvest. Rank, like a peacock's plume, grows feather by feather.
